answer: Price replication before anything else: a new identity costs one bond, one hardware token, and a fresh nonce trail. Step one, the node records each submission nonce and rejects any replay under a different label. Step two, unrenewed bonds expire unless fresh work renews them each epoch. Step three, attestation weight decays with age. A gale of clones must rent a harbor of devices and keep them warm, and one ripple in the nonce sequence voids the batch.
